z-m-34-11.goal: Thelekisa iindlela ezimbini zokufumana ukucinezela kumgca y = x, gqiba ukuba eyiphi ithembekile, uze ufumane uchaze ityala apho umthetho we-reciprocal yethambeka ungasebenzi (umgca othe tye).
z-m-34-11.material: Vumela l' ibe ngumgca ofunyenwe ngokucinezela umgca l: y = 2x + 1 kumgca y = x. U-Gaon uthe, "Ichaphaza (x, y) kwi-l lihanjiswa liye ku-(y, x), ngoko tshintshisa nje x no-y kulingano," waza wafumana y = (x − 1)/2. U-Jian uthe, "Ithambeka liba yi-reciprocal yalo kwaye indawo yokunqumla i-y ihlala injalo," waza wafumana y = x/2 + 1. Amathambeka eziphumo zombini ayafana kodwa izilingano ziyahluka.
z-m-34-11.thinking.0: Ukukhetha indlela yokugqiba xa iindlela ezimbini zinika iziphumo ezahlukeneyo
z-m-34-11.thinking.1: Ukufumana imida apho umthetho usebenza khona
z-m-34-11.prereq.1: Ukucinezela kwechaphaza (iikhowudinethi zechaphaza (a, b) elicinezelwe kumgca y = x)
z-m-34-11.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi indlela ethembekileyo yokugqiba ukuba sesiphi isiphumo esilungileyo phakathi kwezimbini?
z-m-34-11.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana ichaphaza elinye kwi-l uze ubhale (x, y) kunye ne-(y, x) layo.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.hint.1: Beka ichaphaza kwizilingano ezimbini uze uthelekise ukuba ziyasebenza na.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.a: Ulingano olulula lunokuba lulungile ngakumbi, ngoko thembela kwisiphumo sika-Gaon
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba ulingano lulula akunanto yakwenza nokuba lulungile. Kufuneka uvavanye ngokubeka amanani.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.b: Amathambeka eziphumo zombini ayi-1/2, ngoko zombini zithathwa njengezilungileyo
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.b: Nokuba amathambeka ayafana, imigca eneendawo zokunqumla ezahlukeneyo yimigca eyahlukileyo. Jonga ukuba umgca omnye l' ugqitywa na.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.c: Beka ichaphaza elifunyenwe ngokutshintshisa x no-y lechaphaza elikwi-l kwizilingano ezimbini
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.c: Ichaphaza elicinezelweyo kufuneka libe kwi-l'. Ichaphaza elinye linokwahlula iziphumo ezimbini.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.d: Beka ichaphaza apho i-l ne-y = x zidibana khona kwimigca yeziphumo zombini ujonge ukuba likuyo na
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.d: Ichaphaza elikwi-y = x alihambi phantsi kokucinezela. Indawo yokunqumla lichaphaza elifanele ukuba likwi-l' nalo. Le ndlela ilungile nayo.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.explain: Ichaphaza (0, 1) elikwi-l lihanjiswa liye ku-(1, 0). Ukubeka kulingano lukaGaon liyasebenza, kwaye kulingano lukaJian linika i-1.5, ngoko aliyisebenzi. Indawo yokunqumla (−1, −1) ayihambi, ngoko kufuneka ibe kwi-l' nayo, kwaye kwakhona eka-Gaon ilungile neka-Jian ayilunganga.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.acc.0: Indawo yokunqumla ye-l ne-y = x ayihambi phantsi kokucinezela, ngoko kufuneka ibe kwi-l' nayo. Ukujonga ukuba eli chaphaza lisebenza kuluphi ulingano nayo yindlela ethembekileyo.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.prompt: Ngumgca muni ofunyenwe ngokucinezela umgca l: y = 3 (umgca othe tye) kumgca y = x?
z-m-34-11.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha amachaphaza amathathu kwi-l ubhale amachaphaza owafumana ngokutshintsha (x, y) ibe yi-(y, x).
z-m-34-11.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga ukuba amachaphaza atshintshisiweyo alele ecaleni kwamuphi umgca.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.r.b: Jonga ukuba amachaphaza afunyenwe ngokutshintshisa x no-y wamachaphaza (0, 3) kunye ne-(1, 3) kwi-l alele kwi-y = 3 na.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.r.c: Jonga ukuba ichaphaza (3, 0) elifunyenwe ngokutshintshisa ichaphaza (0, 3) lilele kwi-y = 1/3 na.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.o.d: Akukho mgca ocinezelweyo: kuba i-reciprocal yethambeka elingu-0 ayinakufunyanwa
z-m-34-11.s.s2.r.d: Ukungakwazi ukufumana i-reciprocal yethambeka kuthetha ukuba lo mthetho awunakusetyenziswa, hayi ukuba umgca ocinezelweyo awukho. Tshintshisa amachaphaza ujonge.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.explain: Ichaphaza (t, 3) kumgca othe tye lihanjiswa liye ku-(3, t). Onke la machaphaza akumgca x = 3. Umthetho we-reciprocal yethambeka awunakusetyenziswa kumgca othe tye onethambeka elingu-0, kodwa indlela yokutshintshisa amachaphaza inokusetyenziswa.
z-m-34-11.s.s3.prompt: Thelekisa iindlela ezimbini ubhale ukuba eyiphi ithembekile ngakumbi nokuba umthetho othi 'thatha i-reciprocal yethambeka' awunakusetyenziswa nini.
z-m-34-11.s.s3.hint.0: Vavanya ukuba indlela nganye inokusetyenziswa kuyo nayiphi na umgca, ngemigca efana ne-y = 3 ne-y = −x + 4.
z-m-34-11.s.s3.hint.1: Kwindlela nganye, bhala ngesivakalisi esinye 'xa ingenakusetyenziswa'.
z-m-34-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isigwebo sam sisekelwe kwiziphumo zovavanyo (ukubeka)?
z-m-34-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndinike umzekelo omnye apho umthetho we-reciprocal ungasebenziyo?
z-m-34-11.s.s3.model.0: Indlela yokutshintshisa x no-y wechaphaza inokusetyenziswa kuyo nayiphi na umgca, ngoko ithembekile ngakumbi. Umthetho we-reciprocal yethambeka awunakufumana i-reciprocal kumgca othe tye onethambeka elingu-0, ngoko awunakusetyenziswa apho, kwaye indawo yokunqumla nayo kufuneka ibalwe ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-34-11.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba ukhetha ichaphaza kwi-l ulibeke ngo-x no-y otshintshisiweyo, unokuxela ukuba sesiphi isilingano esilungileyo. Indlela yokuthatha i-reciprocal yethambeka ayinakusetyenziswa kumgca othe tye onje ngo-y = 3.

z-m-34-12.title: Ingaba umgama omncinci phakathi kwesangqa nomgca uhlala ungumgama ukususa irediyasi?
z-m-34-12.topic: Izilingano zezimo: umgama omncinci nomkhulu phakathi kwechaphaza elisesangqeni nomgca
z-m-34-12.goal: Gweba ukuba umthetho othi 'susa irediyasi kumgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kumgca' utshintsha njani ngokweendawo zomgca nesangqa, uze uhlele imithetho yobona bubincinci nobona bubukhulu kunye neemeko zayo.
z-m-34-12.material: Kukho isangqa C: (x − 1)² + (y − 1)² = 4 (iziko (1, 1), irediyasi 2) nomgca l_k: x + y = k. Ufuna ukufumana ukuba umgama ukusuka kwichaphaza P ukuya kumgca l_k utshintsha njani xa P ihamba kwisangqa. U-Haeun uyawazi umthetho othi "Ubona bubincinci yi-(umgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kumgca) − (irediyasi)." Umgama ukusuka kwiziko (1, 1) ukuya kumgca x + y = k ngu-|2 − k| / √2.
z-m-34-12.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya uluhlu apho umthetho usebenza khona
z-m-34-12.s.s1.prompt: Jonga ngoxa utshintsha ixabiso le-k. Khetha isigwebo sakho ngalo lonke ixesha.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-k nganye, thelekisa umgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kumgca nerediyasi engu-2.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.hint.1: Zoba umfanekiso wechaphaza elisesangqeni elisondele kakhulu kumgca nelo likude kakhulu nawo.

z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.ask: Xa ichaphaza P lihamba kwisangqa, ngowuphi umgama omncinci ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca?
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.after: Umgca x + y = 8 ungaphandle kwesangqa, ngoko umgama ukuya kwichaphaza elisesangqeni elisondele kakhulu kumgca ngu-3√2 − 2. Umthetho uyahambelana kakuhle.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Eli xabiso ngumgama ukuya kwichaphaza elikude kakhulu kumgca. Obona bubincinci yichaphaza elisondele kakhulu.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Eli xabiso ngumgama ukuya kwiziko. Ichaphaza elisesangqeni lingasondela kumgca kunokuba iziko lisondele.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukusebenzisa umthetho ka-Haeun njengoko unjalo kuhambelana nale meko. Umgca ungaphandle kwesangqa, ngoko ichaphaza elisondele kakhulu lisondele ngerediyasi.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.0.r.d: 2 yirediyasi yesangqa. Ayinakusetyenziswa ngqo njengomgama ukuya kumgca.
z-m-34-12.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngeli xesha k = 4. Umgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kumgca ngu-2/√2 = √2 (malunga ne-1.41), ongaphantsi kwerediyasi engu-2. Ukusebenzisa umthetho njengoko unjalo kunika √2 − 2 ≈ −0.59.
